estimates.assumptions: Pure olive oil contains no carbohydrates or fiber
6 small eggplants ≈ 900 g total raw weight (≈150 g each); using 9 g total carbs and 4.3 g fiber per 100 g raw eggplant
½ tbsp harissa spice blend ≈ 8 g; typical spice blend values ≈ 35–40 g carbs and 15–20 g fiber per 100 g
1 standard 15-oz/425 g can chickpeas, drained weight ≈ 240 g; using standard drained values of ≈31 g total carbs and 8.7 g fiber per 100 g
2 cups halved cherry tomatoes ≈ 300 g; using ≈4 g total carbs and 1.2 g fiber per 100 g
1 1/2 cups nonfat plain Greek yogurt ≈ 360 g; using standard nonfat Greek yogurt values of ≈5.7–6 g total carbs per 100 g with negligible fiber
1 tbsp ground cumin ≈ 6 g; using typical cumin values of ≈44 g total carbs and 10–11 g fiber per 100 g
½ cup chopped parsley ≈ 30 g fresh leaves; using standard fresh parsley values of ≈6–7 g total carbs and 3.3 g fiber per 100 g
